slug: 2024-11-25 Djibouti inaugurates Wingu TO7 Tier-3 data centre and cable landing station

facts.fact: Wingu Africa inaugurated its TO7 Technology Park in Djibouti, which includes a carrier-neutral data centre, in a ceremony attended by the President.
facts.system: Wingu TO7 Technology Park data centre

facts.fact: Wingu Africa describes the TO7 carrier-neutral data centre in Djibouti as Tier-3 with 99.982% uptime (operator's own statement, no Uptime Institute certification named).
facts.system: Wingu TO7 Technology Park data centre

facts.fact: Wingu's existing Djibouti data centre, operating for over a decade, continues alongside the new TO7 facility; date is the article's published date.

systems.system: Wingu TO7 Technology Park data centre
